scope: Full requested V1 outcome readiness separated from bounded offline implementation; no numeric coverage gate

rationale.COACHING_INTELLIGENCE_READINESS: Bounded hash-approved selection and independent quality gates exist; broad capabilities remain open
rationale.FIRST_PRESCRIPTION_READINESS: Productive establishment exists for supported patterns, but train-any-eligible whole-plan competence is unproven
rationale.ADAPTIVE_COACHING_READINESS: Local/suffix/familiar progression selectors do not cover every missed essential/schedule/horizon scenario
rationale.ATHLETE_LEARNING_MODEL_READINESS: Read-only individual evidence and reversible association preference are incomplete as general longitudinal learning
rationale.POSITIVE_PRESCRIPTION_COVERAGE: Designed-case gains do not establish broad V1 population or program coverage
rationale.COACHING_DECISION_QUALITY: Independent bounded quality gate passed, but 19 of 26 positive outputs are acceptable alternatives rather than best-supported and broad holdout capability/context gaps remain; do not equate permissibility with goal-optimal competence
rationale.AUTONOMOUS_COACHING_SPEC_READINESS: Retained V1 program/science/model/horizon gaps prevent autonomous spec readiness
rationale.NEXT_ENGINEERING_STEP: Finish reusable missing coaching and input vocabulary, then evaluate fresh unseen cases before KMP/production prep
